claims.statement: Local toolchain requires Node >=24 and pnpm >=10 with the repo-pinned pnpm@11.25.0 activated via Corepack, installed with frozen lockfile.
The canonical wiki docs run is frozen-lockfile install followed by non-interactive pnpm wiki:update:print, the same command scheduled CI runs.

Repository wiki entrypoints are the pnpm wiki:* scripts: wiki:init for first generation, wiki:update and wiki:update:print for updates, wiki:dry-run for validation, and wiki:visualize for static-site export.
Every wiki script preloads scripts/openwiki-fetch-patch.mjs via node --import, which injects a stable opaque x-opencode-session header on opencode.ai requests.

Inference must use the Responses API (OPENWIKI_OPENAI_COMPATIBLE_USE_RESPONSES_API=true) because the pinned muse-spark model is Responses-only; routing to /chat/completions fails as ModelProtocolUnsupported surfaced as HTTP 401.

Scheduled wiki CI runs daily at 08:00 UTC plus on demand on Node 24, installs with pnpm/action-setup and actions/setup-node, runs the OpenWiki update command, and opens a docs-only PR limited to openwiki, AGENTS.md, and CLAUDE.md.

The normative agent design is the LangGraph reference workflow (understand, retrieve semantic layer, plan, generate/validate/explain/execute/fix SQL, mask PII, chart, reviewer) backed by a common harness contract covering read-only DB tools, semantic search, chart rendering, alerting, skills, and audit traces.

The target database must be a fictional Vietnamese business database with at least 8 related tables, one table of at least one million rows, fake PII columns, and hidden seeded drift/anomaly/injection scenarios loaded by a one-command script.

Every implementation task is constrained by mandatory project rules (self-built agent with no hosted text-to-SQL/BI products, read-only connection-layer enforcement, synthetic-only PII, Python/TypeScript with a LangGraph-style workflow) and the submitted use-case set must cover all eight knowledge areas K1-K8.
Local runs copy .env.example to .env to supply OPENAI_COMPATIBLE_API_KEY and MCP tokens, .env is never committed, and CI instead maps the OPENCODE_GO_API_KEY secret to that variable.

Every pnpm wiki:* script preloads scripts/openwiki-fetch-patch.mjs, which injects a stable opaque x-opencode-session header (ses_ plus 32 hex chars) for opencode.ai requests, deterministic per GitHub run and random per local process without overwriting an existing value.

The wiki read boundary in .openwikiignore excludes secrets, generated state, dependencies and build output, data dumps, and evals, seeded scenarios, manifests, traces, audit payloads, and results, so docs cite loader and schema files and never reproduce ignored contents.

Agent documentation is organized by system rather than source directory: workflow-architecture owns the reference understand-retrieve-plan-generate-validate-cost-gate-execute-mask-chart-review loop, semantic-layer owns the knowledge corpus and hybrid retrieval, and safety-and-access-control owns read-only, validation, cost-gate, RBAC, masking, and injection defenses.

The target business database requires at least 8 related tables with a >=1M-row table and fake-PII columns, plus hidden seeded fixtures of at least 3 drift scenarios, 5 anomalies, and 3 injections, loadable by one command such as python -m data.load.

Submitted use-case designs route to use-cases/text-to-sql for UC-01 bounded self-repair, use-cases/root-cause-and-anomaly for UC-05 branching analysis and UC-10 scheduled anomaly alerts, and integrations/mcp-server for the UC-09 database MCP server and operator surfaces.

Verification routes to evals/eval-and-safety-harness: evals run by one command with execution-accuracy grading, per-UC metrics, regression comparison, hidden gold results, and at least 5 mandatory attack and safety cases.

Hard invariants apply to every agent task: the team self-builds the SQL path without hosted text-to-SQL or BI products, connects with a read-only account enforced at the connection layer, uses only synthetic or public data with fake PII, and implements in Python or TypeScript with a LangGraph-style workflow.

package.json scripts span wiki, database and Docker, data load and verify, tracer and trace display, external client, eval, skills check, alert runner, typecheck and build and clean, workspace check, lint, test, docs interface generation, and semantic indexing.

pnpm docs:interface regenerates docs/mcp_interface.md from the frozen Zod schemas in packages/contracts (list_tables, describe_table, explain_query, run_query, sample_rows plus the shared error-code table with retryable/repairable routing); the generated file must not be hand-edited.

Scheduled wiki CI runs daily at 08:00 UTC plus on demand on Node 24 with pnpm frozen-lockfile install, executes OpenWiki with code --update --print, and opens a docs-only auto-merge PR limited to openwiki, AGENTS.md, and CLAUDE.md.

Wiki runs must not read or reproduce secrets (.env), generated wiki state, dependencies/build output, or ignored data dumps (data/*.csv|*.parquet|*.db|*.sqlite|*.duckdb); documentation covers the loader script and schema files instead.

The monorepo harness foundation (harness architecture, package boundaries, shared contracts, lint boundaries) is built and the reference agent loop with its UC-01 registry extension is implemented, with remaining per-UC designs detailed in docs/UC-plan and the openwiki domain pages.

The harness operator flow runs loopback Postgres via pnpm db:up, seeds Olist-VN data via pnpm data:load with small-scale and verify variants, proves the gateway plus host via pnpm demo:tracer, runs live evals via pnpm eval, and checks skill invariants via pnpm skills:check.

apps/api/src/index.ts implements the full Express operator host (POST /api/ask minting run context with persona-to-principal resolution and SSE streaming, POST /api/runs/:runId/resume continuing on the same thread via Command resume with injected persistence ports) while apps/web/src/app.tsx plus apps/web/src/main.tsx implement the full Vite plus React operator chat UI (persona switcher, /api/ask plus resume streaming, clarification handling) rather than a shell placeholder.

UC wiring goes through the registry seam via registerUC; tracer is the always-registered default route for unknown ucIds, text-to-sql registers from its own subgraph module, and root-cause-analysis registers from its RCA module.
pnpm demo:tracer is the end-to-end gateway plus host proof that asserts a PII-clean trace bundle with 8 trace events.

The API host exposes POST /api/ask and POST /api/runs/:runId/resume on the same thread, injects PostgresSaver plus AppStateStore persistence ports that fail fast without HARNESS_STATE_DATABASE_URL, and streams only allowlisted schema-validated SSE events.
.openwikiignore excludes secrets, generated wiki state, dependencies and build output, data dumps, and evals plus seeded scenarios plus seed manifests plus traces plus results from wiki indexing.

The repository is the SE373 Analytics Agent: a TypeScript LangGraph agent with an MCP db-tools gateway, Postgres 16 plus pgvector, and a React plus Vite operator UI over a fictional Vietnamese business database.

Loopback service ports are 5433 for Postgres, 8081 for the MCP gateway, 3001 for the API, and 5173 for the web UI, served from pgvector/pgvector:0.8.7-pg16 with owner, agent_ro, indexer, and harness_state roles.
The full stack starts with docker compose up with build plus ps, logs, down, and down -v variants or the pnpm docker:* wrappers, while seed loading is a one-off profile-gated data service run.

Local iteration without Docker runs the database container plus the MCP gateway from packages/mcp-server/src/server.ts, the API host from apps/api/src/index.ts, and the web dev server, verified via the api and mcp healthz endpoints.
The agent root builder in packages/agent/src/graph.ts is frozen and gains use-case wiring only through the registry seam registerUC, with tracer as the default route for unknown ucIds.

The API host mints run and thread context, maps UI persona to MCP principal, streams allowlisted sanitized SSE events, and boots persistence only from HARNESS_STATE_DATABASE_URL, failing fast when it is absent.

The MCP server is the sole database caller as role agent_ro and funnels every tool call through auth, scope, zod validation, sqlGuard, AccessPolicy, read-only execution, and PII scan plus audit stages.
The semantic retrieval index is built incrementally into semantic_chunks with content-hash dedup by pnpm semantic:index running as the indexer role.

The dataset is Vietnamized Olist e-commerce with provinces, translated categories, VND conversion, shifted dates, an order_items table expanded to about one million rows with fake vi_VN PII, loaded full in minutes or small scale for CI and pinned by data:verify.
